description: This file defines the YearFrac class which implements the YEARFRAC function used for calculating the fraction of a year between two dates based on different calculation methods. It contains methods for handling date calculations and integrates with other components of PhpSpreadsheet's calculation engine.

classes.name: YearFrac
classes.description: A class implementing the Excel YEARFRAC function to calculate the proportion of a year between two dates based on various methods.

methods.name: fraction
methods.description: Calculates the fraction of a year between two dates using specified methods. Supports array inputs for bulk calculations.

methods.name: excelBug
methods.description: Adjusts date values for a known Excel 1900 leap year bug related to date input of null.

methods.name: method1
methods.description: Calculates the fractional year between two dates based on actual/actual method, considering leap years and different periods.
